findings.location: III. Patterns of True Worship, prayer paragraph (Acts 6:4)
findings.source_quote: Prayer meeting attendance was not a monthly or a bimonthly option (Act 6:4)!
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the reference with “(Matendo 6:4)” and translate the sentence as “Kuhudhuria mikutano ya maombi halikuwa chaguo la kila mwezi au la kila baada ya miezi miwili (Matendo 6:4)!”
findings.translation_quote: Kuhudhuria mikutano ya maombi halikuwa chaguo la mara moja kwa mwezi au mara mbili kwa mwezi (Matendo 6:4)!

findings.location: III. Patterns of True Worship, prayer paragraph (Acts 12:5)
findings.source_quote: When Peter was in prison, they had a voluntary, round-the-clock, prayer chain (Acts 12:5).
findings.suggested_fix: Translate “round-the-clock” as continuous coverage around the clock, for example: “Petro alipokuwa gerezani, waliendesha mnyororo wa maombi wa hiari uliodumu saa zote (Matendo 12:5).”
findings.translation_quote: Petro alipokuwa gerezani, walikuwa na mnyororo wa maombi wa hiari wa saa zote (Matendo 12:5).

findings.location: III. Patterns of True Worship, singing subsection, Ephesians 5:19 quotation
findings.source_quote: “Making melody in your heart” involves the accompaniment of the heart.
findings.suggested_fix: Revise the quotation and its explanation to convey making music in the heart, rather than making a musical sound. For example: “ ‘Kufanya muziki moyoni mwako’ kunamaanisha kuimba kwa kuambatana na moyo.” Preserve the source’s emphasis that the heart accompanies the singing.
findings.translation_quote: “Kufanya sauti ya muziki moyoni mwako” kunahusisha moyo kuandamana na uimbaji.

findings.source_quote: The Menace of the Religious Movie
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the title as “Tishio la Filamu ya Kidini,” retaining the singular meaning of “Movie.”
